pages.en: One morning, Tom doesn't feel well. He has a cold and a high temperature. "No school today," says Mum. "Stay in bed and rest."
pages.zh: 一天早上，Tom 觉得不舒服。他感冒了，还发了高烧。“今天不去上学了，”妈妈说，“待在床上好好休息。”
pages.scene: Tom in bed with a red nose and a blanket, looking tired, Mum sitting on the bed and touching his head, a glass of water on the table.

pages.en: Mum takes Tom to see Dr Brown. The doctor checks his ears and his mouth. "Drink lots of water and take this medicine," she says.
pages.zh: 妈妈带 Tom 去看 Brown 医生。医生检查了他的耳朵和嘴巴。“多喝水，吃这个药，”她说。
pages.scene: A friendly doctor's room, a kind woman doctor in a white coat looking in Tom's ear, Tom sitting on Mum's knee, a bottle of medicine on the desk.

pages.en: Lily reads Tom a story, and Max sits next to his bed. Three days later, Tom feels better. He runs in the garden with Max again!
pages.zh: Lily 给 Tom 读故事，Max 坐在他床边。三天后，Tom 好多了。他又和 Max 在花园里跑起来了！
pages.scene: A sunny garden, Tom running and laughing with Max, Lily waving from the back door, flowers and green grass.

questions.q: Tom goes to school with a cold.
Tom feels better after three days.
questions.zh: 三天后 Tom 好多了。
